name: Synn
message: 「Phew, we managed to drive them off...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Something like this is a piece of cake!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, shall we head back for now?」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, to think demons snuck onto the academy grounds again...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Omake-san and her little sister sneak in all the time, don't they?」

name: Ria
message: 「The increasing frequency of them showing up on campus is certainly concerning...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could someone perhaps be guiding them in?」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder if there's some other reason the demons are gathering here.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I got it, there's something tasty around here!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If that were the case, Omake-san would be hanging around here every single day.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Your little sister is a good person, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, it's not like we have any other leads...」

name: Ria
message: 「For now, let's just keep in mind that it's a possibility.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could this also be the influence of Re-Crea?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My goodness, the world sure is full of Buddhist monks these days.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Rolo-chan, if you space out like that, you might get attacked too, you know?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There is no need to worry. Jiiya will protect me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're a guy, so shape up and stay sharp.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun is always so unreliable, isn't he?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What would you do if, by some slim chance, something happened to me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, you don't even need my help, do you?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The treasurer sure is tough, isn't she?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'm plenty delicate in my own way too!」

name: Ria
message: 「A-Anyway, let's stay on our guard going forward, okay?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord, aren't you heading home?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh good, you didn't have your part-time job today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, just came to check on you a bit.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, things have been pretty dangerous lately, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. So I was wondering if you were doing okay.」

name: Macaron
message: 「What, are you trying to say I'm weak or something!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no! I was just simply worried about you......」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just leave the little shrimp alone, leave her alone.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmph! I'm not as tiny as you, little panda!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aah...... You feel so nice to touch......」

name: Paqy
message: 「H-Hey, let go of me, damn it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Good for you, Paqy, getting all that affection.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch, the great me only acknowledges Ria-chan's boobs!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Maybe I'll make panda hotpot for dinner tonight.」

name: Synn
message: 「Your knife work is as impressive as ever...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Like I said, it's not a knife, it's Alzard.」
In a way, Macaron is the most dangerous one here.
A flashy keychain dangles from the pommel.

name: Macaron
message: 「When I swing it like this, it looks awesome.」
Somehow, it seems like whenever Macaron lets go of Alzard, she regresses into acting like a little kid...
For her, it's probably pretty embarrassing, I'm sure.
...I wonder if she's stressed out or something.

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother, you're being mean to me again!」

name: Synn
message: 「I was just wondering how amazing you really are, Macaron...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I-If you say you absolutely have to see, then maybe just a little...」

name: Synn
message: 「No, you don't have to force yourself.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't want to make you do something you hate, Macaron...」

name: Macaron
message: 「D-Don't underestimate me! I'm not forcing myself at all!」

name: Macaron
message: 「As long as I brace myself properly, I'll be totally fine...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides, it's something I'll have to let go of eventually anyway...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Once I become a full-fledged Demon Lord, yeah...」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I just think of it as practice for when that time comes, I'm fine!」

name: Macaron
message: 「And maybe this could actually be a good opportunity...」

name: Macaron
message: 「So, just for a little bit, okay...」
I firmly grip the hilt that was timidly held out to me.
It feels almost as if I'm accepting Macaron's trust......
Alzard itself doesn't feel as heavy as it looks.
Yet for some reason, nervousness makes both of my arms tremble.

name: Synn
message: 「Looking at it up close again, it really is huge......」
Already, teary eyes were looking up at me.
And just like that, she puffs out her cheeks.

name: Macaron
message: 「You can use magic! Hey, that's it, isn't it~!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because you're holding Alzard! How? Hey, how~?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Looks like that sword can't be wielded by someone without magic power.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, that's pretty common for weapons from the Demon World.」
She hasn't figured out that I'm the Demon Lord, right...?
I really don't want to cause any weird trouble in a place like this....

name: Synn
message: 「B-But look, Paqy acted as a cushion.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're definitely going to make a great wife, Macaron.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Wh-What are you saying!? Are you an idiot!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I don't even want to become something like that!」

name: Macaron
message: 「As long as I become a splendid Demon Lord, that's all that matters!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides, I'm sure Master is hoping for that too...」

name: Synn
message: 「What kind of person is your Master?」

name: Macaron
message: 「You see, a long time ago, I was kidnapped by a bad Demon.」

name: Macaron
message: 「And you know, the one who rescued me back then was Master.」

name: Macaron
message: 「They were strong, brave, trusted by their comrades, and kind...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ever since I was little, I was raised to become the king of the Ratafia Kingdom-a Demon Lord-but...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Seeing Master back then showed me what a true Demon Lord really is.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Not Papa or Mama, it was Master who taught me everything.」

name: Synn
message: 「Your Master was a Demon Lord too?」

name: Macaron
message: 「That's what they called themselves. There's no mistake.」
Still, back when my dad was the Demon Lord, Macaron probably wasn't even born yet, so it must be someone else....

name: Synn
message: 「Say, Macaron, do you love your Master?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, well, yeah, of course you do...」

name: Synn
message: 「So, did the part-time jobs and sleeping outside come from your Master too?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yep. Daily labor and an independent lifestyle! Apparently, those are the basics of being a Demon Lord.」
Still, I guess that's what moved the heart of a princess who was educated to be a Demon Lord.

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, isn't sleeping outside pretty rough in this season?」

name: Synn
message: 「At the very least, you ought to stay somewhere proper...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm totally fine, something like that's no big deal.」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, it's only going to get colder from here.」

name: Synn
message: 「You didn't look like you were feeling too great yesterday or this morning, either.」

name: Synn
message: 「I know those teachings are important to you, but if you wreck your health over them, it'll all be for nothing.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I don't really have anywhere to go, anyway...」

name: Synn
message: 「We happen to have plenty of spare rooms, you know.」

name: Macaron
message: 「No way. I can't impose on you that much.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, don't worry about it.」

name: Macaron
message: 「That's why I'm telling you, stop spoiling me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Seeing how hard you're trying really moved my heart...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Master had a side like that too, now that I think about it--」

name: Macaron
message: 「You're way lamer about it than him, though.」

name: Macaron
message: 「After all, I'd feel bad for you if I turned down such a kind offer, Big Brother.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Once the cold gets too much to bear, I might just take you up on it.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides, it looks like I'll be able to have my match against the Crusaders pretty soon too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You were tryin' awfully hard to sweet-talk that squirt, weren't ya?」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Could you refrain from saying things that invite misunderstandings like that.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's the big deal with takin' her side so much?」

name: Synn
message: 「I just want to get along with everyone.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah. I think that's what's great about you, Demon Lord.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Besides, truth is, I've got somethin' on my mind too...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ah--nah, I'm sure I'm just overthinkin' it. Forget it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Really? You'll go bald if you worry too much on your own.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Are you not going to accept the invitation from the president?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I told you I'd think about it!」

name: Melphas
message: 「It does not seem like such a bad offer for you, Princess.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Like I said, there's a lot to consider!」

name: Macaron
message: 「You know... getting psyched up, preparing myself mentally, and stuff!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides, you know. There's something bothering me too...」

name: Macaron
message: 「There's no way an ordinary human could wield Alzard...」
